text: {"label":"Behavioral Coaching for Sports Performance","definition":"Applying behavior-analytic coaching procedures such as behavioral skills training, video feedback, shaping, and TAGteach to improve athletes' sport-specific skills, safe technique, and practice performance across team and individual sports.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets athletic skill execution and coaching in competitive sport, not general physical activity or exercise, classroom group contingencies like the Good Behavior Game, or general skill-acquisition procedures."}
